# Code in the images that the submitted configurations do not enable (G3, G6, G6b, G6c)

Classification: Internal (becomes public with the MLPerf Training v6.1 results)

G3, G6 and G6b, where named below, are Firmus's earlier GPT-OSS NVFP4 packages (`nemo_g3_nvfp4_v1`, `nemo_g6_nvfp4_v2`,
`nemo_g6b_nvfp4_v2_1`), withdrawn from this submission and no longer in this repository. This list was made for all
four and is kept whole; only G6c is submitted ([Index](../KERNELS.md), "Earlier packages").

The patches and `pretrain.py` contain paths that the scored runs do not take. This list lets a reviewer skip them. It
was made by listing every `NVFP4_*`, `NVTE_*` and `DGLU_*` variable that the package code reads (`pretrain.py`,
`nvfp4_clip_adam.py`, `dglu_kernel_ep.py`, `docker/patches/*.patch`) and comparing that list with the configs
(`config_GB300_2x4x3xtp1pp1cp1ep1_nvfp4_ag6.sh` for G3, `..._nvfp4_v7.sh` for G6 and G6b, plus `config_common.sh`).
The Megatron, TE NVFP4, cuDNN FE and permutation patches are byte-identical in the three packages. The V7 patch exists
only in G6 and G6b and is identical there. G6b's `pretrain.py` equals G6's, and G3's is G6's without the three V7 hook
groups: the `pretrain.py` line numbers below give G3 / G6 (= G6b). "TE patch" means `transformer_engine_firmus_nvfp4.patch`
and "v7" means `transformer_engine_firmus_v7.patch`.

**G6c.** The patches, `Dockerfile`, `nvfp4_clip_adam.py`, `clip_adam_ext.cu` and `dglu_kernel_ep.py` are
byte-identical to G6b's; `pretrain.py`, `conf/gpt_oss.yaml` and the config differ, and `firmus_kernels/` and
`opt_kernels/` are new. Its config differs from G6b's only in the switches of the next section and in five new ones,
`NVFP4_AMAX_DBIAS_COLS` (K8.5), `NVFP4_SWA_PDKDV` (K10.2), `OPT_QKNORM_ROPE`, `OPT_QKNORM_ROPE_STRICT` (K10.1) and
`FIRMUS_RESGRAD_FWD_NOBIAS` (K10.3), so the tables after it hold for G6c as for G6b ("all" and "G6, G6b" include G6c;
`NVFP4_ZERO_HIDDEN_PAD` is 1). Their `pretrain.py` lines are G6's; the G6c lines are: Triton Adam L911, side-stream
Adam L399, early L2 norm L677, early dense all-gather L805, FP4 parameter gather L1188, L1211, BF16 grads under PAO
L1279, Megatron bias-dropout fusion L1088, in-training checks L312, L150, L718, L624. The new files read
`OPT_QKNORM_ROPE*` (K10.1), `NVFP4_SWA_*` and `NVFP4_FULL_ATTN_FP8*` (K5.1, K10.2), `NVFP4_QKV_PACKED_AMAX` (K8.6) and
`NVFP4_UNPERMUTE_BIAS_*`, `NVFP4_RESGRAD_FWD`, `NVFP4_DEFER_FC2_BIAS` (K10.3).

## G6c: paths the reference model does not use

The 20261012 reference model has no linear biases (`add_bias_linear` False, `conf/gpt_oss.yaml` L34), no attention
sinks (`attention_softmax_type` vanilla, L36), no clamped quick-GELU (`clamped_quick_gelu_activation` False, L38) and
QK RMSNorm (L37). These items of G6 / G6b are off or not reached in G6c; their write-ups are not part of this
package.

| Item | Switch in G6c | Why it is off or not reached |
|---|---|---|
| K3.2 FC1 bias fold | `NVFP4_FOLD_FC1_BIAS=0` (L109), `NVFP4_FREEZE_FOLDED_BIAS=0` (L112) | Off, as in G6 and G6b; there is no FC1 bias to fold. |
| K3.4 FC2 expert bias in unpermute | `NVFP4_DEFER_FC2_BIAS=0` (L95), `NVFP4_DEFER_FC2_BIAS_BF16=0` (L96) | No expert bias. The deferral needs the FC2 bias (TE patch L2123–2127); the tail wrapper (`pretrain.py` L218–243) is not installed. `NVFP4_UNPERMUTE_BIAS_UNROLL` / `_WARPS` (set) are used by K10.3's kernel; the K3.4 unpermute reads them only with a deferred bias (TE patch L3754–3786). |
| K5.2 Triton QKV + RoPE | `NVFP4_TRITON_QKV_ROPE=0` (L147) | The block `pretrain.py` L71–87 (and the K8.6 hook nested in it, L83–87) is not executed. With QK RMSNorm the RoPE is NVIDIA's fused QK-norm + RoPE (K10.1); K8.6 is installed from K10.1's file. |
| K5.4 attention bias + residual | `NVFP4_FUSED_BIAS_RESIDUAL=0` (L113) | No attention output bias. `pretrain.py` L89–106 is not executed; the attention residual add is K8.4's `_ResidualAdd` (v7 L2298–2299). |
| K5.5 interleaved clamped SwiGLU | `NVFP4_TRITON_INTERLEAVED_GLU` not set (default "1") | The Triton path requires `ScaledClampedQGeGLU` (TE patch L1389); this model's experts use SiLU without clamp or offset (`pretrain.py` L1061–1064), so the gate is never true. |
| K5.8 FC1 dbias in a Triton reduction | `NVFP4_DGLU_TRITON_DBIAS=0` (L99) | No FC1 bias; `triton_fc1_dbias` also requires `fc1_op.has_bias` (TE patch L2228–2233). K8.5 computes the amaxes only. |
| K8.4 forward part | `NVFP4_RESGRAD_FWD=0` (L137) | Needs the deferred FC2 bias (v7 L2340–2343); replaced by K10.3 (`FIRMUS_RESGRAD_FWD_NOBIAS=1`), which raises if it is on. |
| K5.1 TE-patch module | `NVFP4_SWA_TRITON=1` | `pretrain.py` L131 imports `firmus_kernels.swa_attention` (K10.2) instead; the TE-patch `nvfp4_swa_attention` (TE patch L241–807) is in the image and not called. |
| Learnable sinks, clamped quick-GELU | model settings | The sink path of K10.2 (`HAS_SINK=True`) and the `quick_gelu` branch of `pretrain.py` L1061–1062 are not taken. |

## Set in the config, without effect

| Switch | Value | Why it has no effect |
|---|---|---|
| `NVFP4_CACHED_WEIGHT_QUANT` | 1 (all) | `_quantize_expert_weights_impl` returns from the K6.2 path first (TE patch L1678–1681); 0 calls in job 22329. See K6.1. |
| `NVFP4_CUDA_GRAPH`, `NVFP4_CUDA_GRAPH_IMPLEMENTATION`, `NVFP4_CUDA_GRAPH_SCOPE` | 1, `transformer_engine`, `[attn,moe]` (all) | No package file reads them. The graphs come from `MCORE_CUDA_GRAPH`, `CUDA_GRAPH_IMPLEMENTATION`, `CUDA_GRAPH_SCOPE` via `conf/gpt_oss.yaml` L66–68. See K7.3. |
| `NVFP4_DQGEGLU_DIRECT_MODE`, `NVFP4_DQGEGLU_FIXED_GLOBAL_SCALE` | `none`, 8192 (all) | Read only when `NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_DQGEGLU_NVFP4=1` (TE patch L2220–2223; reads at L2314 and L2332, inside `if use_fused_dqgeglu_nvfp4` at L2312; cuDNN FE patch L458, inside the `generate_nvfp4_output` branch that starts at L406); the configs set it to 0. See K5.7. |
| `NVFP4_MASK_PADDED_MAIN_GRAD` | 0 (all) | Read only by the FC2 mask hook (Megatron patch L285), which is registered only when `NVFP4_ZERO_FC1_PAD_ROWS` is off or `NVFP4_DEBUG_PAD_DRIFT=1` (L359–360); the configs set `NVFP4_ZERO_FC1_PAD_ROWS=1` and do not set `NVFP4_DEBUG_PAD_DRIFT`. See K3.1. |
| `NVFP4_MBS` | 3 (all) | No package file reads it. See K5.9. |

## Patch applied, not active

`te_fused_permutation_2880_2944.patch` (identical in the three packages) is applied by `Dockerfile`
. Its only switches are
`NVFP4_PERMUTE_PADDED_HIDDEN` and `NVFP4_PERMUTE_LOGICAL_HIDDEN` (patch L270, L293), which no config or package file
sets. Unset, `get_env_hidden_size` returns the input width (L255–259), so the permute and unpermute outputs keep the
input width.

## Not set in G6c; the default applies

`OPT_QKNORM_ROPE_SELFCHECK` ("1": the start-up self-check compares the forward only; ≥ 2 adds the backward,
`opt_kernels/qknorm_rope_patch.py` L20, L146) and the `OPT_QKNORM_ROPE_FWD_ROWS`, `_BWD_ROWS`, `_BWD_CTAS`,
`_FWD_WARPS`, `_BWD_WARPS` tile sizes (`opt_kernels/qknorm_rope.py` L26–30) (K10.1); `NVFP4_SWA_PFWD`, `_PDQ`,
`_PACKED` (K10.2).

## Not set; the default is on (these paths ran)

These are not disabled code. They are listed because they are absent from the config: `NVFP4_SWA_PACKED`
("1", K5.1), `NVFP4_UNPERMUTE_FULL_ROW` ("1") and `NVFP4_UNPERMUTE_WARPS` ("4") (K3.3), `NVFP4_TRITON_INTERLEAVED_GLU`
("1", K5.5), `NVFP4_TAIL_MXFP8_ATTN`, `NVFP4_TAIL_MXFP8_MLP` ("1"), `NVFP4_TAIL_MXFP8_FORMAT` and
`NVFP4_LMHEAD_MXFP8_FORMAT` ("e4m3") (K2.2, K2.3), `NVFP4_RMSNORM_BWD_UNROLL` ("1", K5.3), `NVFP4_FAST_BOUNDARY_PAD`
("1"), `NVFP4_FC1_FOLDED_BIAS_COLUMN` ("2880", used only with the fold), and in G6/G6b the `NVFP4_DYSTATS_*` tile sizes
and `NVFP4_AMAX_DBIAS_COLS*` (K8.5).
In G6c `NVFP4_AMAX_DBIAS_COLS` is set (448, K8.5), the `NVFP4_TRITON_INTERLEAVED_GLU` path is not reached and
`NVFP4_SWA_PACKED` applies to `firmus_kernels/swa_attention.py` (section "G6c" above).

## Open points

1. The defaults were read from the package code by searching for `os.environ.get("NAME", default)`.
   A variable read in another form (for example C++ `getenv`, or `os.getenv`) is covered only where found:
   `NVTE_NVFP4_RHT_FUSION_COLS64` (v7 L11, set, K8.7), `NVFP4_DQGEGLU_FIXED_GLOBAL_SCALE` (cuDNN FE patch L458, set,
   without effect, K5.7), `NVFP4_PERMUTE_PADDED_HIDDEN` / `NVFP4_PERMUTE_LOGICAL_HIDDEN`
   (`te_fused_permutation_2880_2944.patch` L270, L293, not set) and `NVFP4_DBIAS_*` (TE patch L3544–3546, tile sizes).
